quarterly_data.signal: DoD award: fixed-price incentive (firm-target) contract N0001926C1022 to Northrop Grumman Systems Corp. (Linthicum Heights, Maryland) for F-35 APG-85 Lot 7 long-lead materials, parts and components supporting delivery of sixty-seven production radars for the Air Force, Marine Corps and Navy; expected completion February 2031; not competitively procured; contracting activity Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland.

DoD award: modification P00005 to firm-fixed-price IDIQ contract N0001924D0104 with Northrop Grumman Systems Corp. (Keyser, West Virginia), raising the ceiling to $462,446,441 from $365,441,776 for production of the FMU-139D/B Fuze System, accessory kits, trainer fuzes and related hardware for the Navy, Air Force and Foreign Military Sales customers; work mainly in Rocket Center, West Virginia (91%), expected completion September 2030; contracting activity Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland.

DoD award: modification P00188 to contract FA8615-17-C-6047 with Northrop Grumman Systems Corp. (Rolling Meadows, Illinois) for the Integrated Viper Electronic Warfare Suite Electronic Warfare Radio Frequency Compatibility Program Low-rate Initial Production effort, bringing cumulative face value to $1,921,299,231 from $1,833,881,427; expected completion Dec. 31, 2029; contracting activity Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio.
